body:
> I found that reverting commit https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/3cf0881c36f54a65317115851cc2f29c0c862f59 also prevents the crash. However, doing a pure revert would mark the single-sampled resolve destination target as discardable, which may cause rendering regressions on mobile and WebGPU targets that take DONT_CARE literally.

Reverting 3cf0881c36f54a65317115851cc2f29c0c862f59  would bring back the bug it fixed (https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/115522), so its not really an option. 

That being said, this PR is not the correct fix. MSAA buffers should always be safe to mark as discardable since by nature, they need to be resolved before being used. I have a feeling the true problem comes from how we do the blit from the Canvas background
